blocks.orig: A walking safari of 1.5 to 4 hours through Arusha National Park is said to be unforgettable. Guided by an experienced ranger, you get up close with giraffes, buffalos, zebras, warthogs, and blue monkeys while learning about the park’s unique flora and fauna. You, for example, pass by an impressive waterfall, the Ngurdoto Crater, and Lake Momella. And if you are lucky you will also see flocks of flamingos and the impressive Colobus monkey swinging through the trees.
blocks.html: Exploring Arusha National Park on foot, on a walking safari of 1.5 to 4 hours, is said to be an unforgettable experience. An experienced ranger leads the way and brings you close to zebras, warthogs, giraffes, buffalos and blue monkeys, telling you about the park’s special plant and animal life as you go. On the way you see, for example, Lake Momella, the Ngurdoto Crater and an impressive waterfall. With some luck, you also spot flocks of flamingos and the impressive Colobus monkey swinging through the treetops.
